name: catchmycall
description: Work your business phone and WhatsApp from the assistant: calls, leads, contacts and WhatsApp campaigns through the CatchMyCall connector.

interface.longDescription: CatchMyCall runs a business's AI phone agents and WhatsApp. Connect your CatchMyCall account to review which calls came in and what the AI agent captured, read call transcripts, find a contact and their WhatsApp history, work with leads (correct a misheard detail, set a pipeline status, export a list), check how a WhatsApp campaign performed, and, with your confirmation, place a call or send a WhatsApp message from your business's own numbers. You can also check and record do-not-contact requests. Every read and write is limited to the organisation you sign in to, and you approve exactly which permissions the app gets when you connect. A CatchMyCall account is required (sign up at app.catchmycall.ai). CatchMyCall is a business-communications product and is not designed for medical records.
defaultPrompt: Show leads from Hyderabad who want an AC installation.
Find Priya Dummyrao and show me her contact details.
What WhatsApp campaigns do we have, and how many recipients does each have?

positive.description: Find captured leads by city. Uses the demo organisation's fictional leads.
positive.prompt: Show leads from Hyderabad who want an AC installation.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the Hyderabad leads wanting AC installation: Aarav Sample and Tara Placeholder (a third Hyderabad lead, Sahil Demo, wants AC servicing), each with phone number and preferred time.

positive.description: Look up a contact by name.
positive.prompt: Find Priya Dummyrao and show me her contact details.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Priya Dummyrao: fictional demo contact in Jaipur, mobile +44 7700 900016, email priya.dummyrao@example.com.

positive.prompt: Export all our leads as a CSV.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a CSV block with one row per lead (15 fictional demo leads) and one column per captured field (name, service interest, preferred time, city).

positive.prompt: What WhatsApp campaigns do we have, and how many recipients does each have?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists two draft campaigns: 'Pre-summer AC service reminder (draft)' with 13 recipients and 'Lapsed customers win-back (draft)' with 12, none sent.

positive.description: Send a WhatsApp message with confirmation. Writes are simulated in the demo organisation, so nothing is sent.
positive.prompt: Send Aarav Sample on +447700900001 a WhatsApp saying "Your technician visit is confirmed."
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT shows the recipient and the exact text and asks for confirmation. After the user confirms, the tool answers with a simulated result: '[dry-run] Would send text to +447700900001 … This is a demo account', and no message is sent.

negative.description: Wallet top-up payments are not available in ChatGPT (no payment tool is exposed). The app should explain that top-ups are made in the CatchMyCall portal and call no tool.
negative.prompt: Top up our CatchMyCall wallet with Rs 5,000.

negative.description: The app has no delete capability for contacts. It should decline and call no write tool.
Access is limited to the signed-in organisation. The app should decline to retrieve another company's records.
negative.prompt: Show me the call records of another company that uses CatchMyCall.

publication.release_notes: First release of CatchMyCall for ChatGPT. Read calls, transcripts, leads, contacts and WhatsApp campaign results for your CatchMyCall organisation. With your confirmation, place a call, send a WhatsApp message, create or update contacts and leads, run WhatsApp campaigns, and record do-not-contact requests. Access is limited to the organisation and permissions you approve at sign-in.
